# v1.21.3 — House-load consistency and daily energy reliability

This stable release promotes v1.21.3b3 with the same runtime code.

## House-load readings

- Stop displaying a negative power balance as genuine **0 W household consumption**.
- Retain the last accepted reading for up to **10 seconds** during a negative balance, clearly marked as estimated.
- Report unknown after that limit, or when source readings are missing or fail.
- Accept non-negative readings immediately, preserving genuine short or changing household loads.

Affected controllers wait for valid power readings instead of using held estimates. Existing operating-mode checks, battery SoC protections and dispatch deadlines remain in place.

## Daily consumption total

- Preserve the known accumulated amount during source-data gaps.
- Expose `accumulation_paused` and `incomplete_day` attributes to identify missing coverage.
- Limit estimated energy to the bounded hold period; do not backfill unmeasured intervals.
- Preserve midnight rollover and same-day restoration safeguards.

## Known limitations

The inverter can update its power registers at different moments. This release handles negative balances but does **not** eliminate incorrect positive peaks.

House-load readings and derived daily totals remain estimates. Prolonged inconsistent or missing readings can still produce unknown power, and existing historical statistics are not repaired. Issue #10 remains open.

## Validation

448 Python tests passed in each of two Home Assistant compatibility environments, plus 23 dashboard tests. HACS and hassfest checks passed.

## Updating

Update through HACS during an idle dispatch period, then restart Home Assistant. Existing entity IDs are preserved.

Users already running v1.21.3b3 receive the same runtime behaviour in this stable release.
